strings.name: Tim Clark
strings.summary: Tim Clark is a British airline executive who joined Emirates’ founding team as head of airline planning in 1985 and became president in 2003. He helped develop its Dubai-centered international network and also served as managing director of SriLankan Airlines. His work spans route, fleet and passenger-service strategy.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Airline president, group chairman and CEO, team achievements, individual contributions, honorary degrees and earned qualifications are distinguished. Retirement intentions are not fixed departure dates.
strings.influence.rationale: Helped build Emirates’ international route network, influencing global long-haul airline services.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Earned an economics degree from the University of London in 1971; Warwick’s Doctor of Laws is honorary.
strings.facts.f2.label: Role boundaries
strings.facts.f2.value: Current president of Emirates Airline; managing director of SriLankan Airlines from April 1998 to March 2008.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Dubai hub network
strings.highlights.h1.text: Applied route-planning experience to connect regional markets and develop Dubai as an international connecting hub.
strings.highlights.h2.title: A long aviation career
strings.highlights.h2.text: Worked in airline operations and planning at British Caledonian, Gulf Air and Emirates; company development also depends on management teams and operational staff.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Retirement remains conditional
strings.timeline.t1.text: CAPA reports the following day that he may retire in 2028 if the company stabilizes; this is not a completed departure or confirmed handover.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Receives ATW Lifetime Achievement Award
strings.timeline.t2.text: Emirates’ official biography records Air Transport World’s individual lifetime achievement award.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Receives KBE honor
strings.timeline.t3.text: Named in the 2014 New Year Honours for services to British prosperity and aviation.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Becomes Emirates Airline president
strings.timeline.t4.text: After years on the founding planning team, becomes president, a separate role from group chairman and CEO.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Also becomes SriLankan managing director
strings.timeline.t5.text: Takes the role after Emirates acquires a major stake and management control; serves until March 2008.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joins Emirates’ founding team
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moves to Dubai as head of airline planning, helping develop the new airline’s routes.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joins Gulf Air
strings.timeline.t7.text: Works for Gulf Air in Bahrain, gaining route-planning experience.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Enters civil aviation
strings.timeline.t8.text: Joins British Caledonian, beginning his airline career.
